comparison.objective: Set a grinder tool rest and tongue guard to prescribed clearances and secure the rest before starting; candidate sets and secures two proximity switches to sensing clearances.
comparison.physical_skill: Slide mounted components to measured gaps and clamp without contact versus loosen-slide-sense-hold-retighten registration.
comparison.success_condition: Both adjustments must be within 3/6 mm, not touch the wheel, and the rest must be clamped before START; candidate requires two ≤6 mm over-center states retained after tightening.
comparison.reason: Both centrally test positioning mounted hardware to a clearance, locking it without losing the setting, and validating safe operation. The indicator and screw tool add procedure but not a meaningfully different tested ability; candidate also lacks numeric tightening drift and torque limits.
